name: agent-body
description: Agent Body contracts runtime (W032, the tradrl-information structure pattern): the typed contracts for an agent's BODY — the part that acts in a world. A Body is a participant bound to one world (the W003 Participant interop; the W023-era seat kinds flow through) with a declared embodiment (instruments/venues it may touch, order kinds, TIFs, command kinds), a declared risk envelope (the A13 RiskLimits shape — the runtime gate enforces; a Body looser than its world's limits is invalid at attach, never silently clipped), an attach → active → detached fail-closed lifecycle as pure data transforms, and the A7 observation firewall (available-then grants; withheld artifacts are named). No runtime intelligence — that is W033's Cognitive Substrate (R050).
